faqs.question: How does the 7-day free trial work?
faqs.answer: You receive full, unrestricted access to your chosen tier for 168 hours (7 days). No credit card is required at signup. At the end of 7 days, your workspace enters read-only mode until a commercial subscription is activated.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my tier later?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can switch between Starter, Control, and Pro at any time from your in-app Billing Center. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated billing.

faqs.question: What happens if I exceed my monthly transaction or OCR limits?
faqs.answer: We never freeze read access or interrupt core cash visibility. When you approach 80% and 100% of your quota, the system sends an email notification and provides an option to upgrade or purchase additional unit packs.

faqs.question: Does CFO AI replace my local Indonesian tax consultant (Konsultan Pajak)?
faqs.answer: No. CFO AI prepares, structures, and reconciles your general ledger, e-Bupot calculations, and PMK 81/2024 CoreTax schedules. It provides organized readiness exports for your licensed consultant or internal finance team, but does not provide legal tax representation.

en.title: PT PMA Tax Obligations in Indonesia: Complete 2026 Director's Compliance Guide
en.excerpt: A definitive guide for foreign directors and finance leaders navigating Indonesian corporate income tax, withholding rules, PPN 11%, CoreTax transition, and quarterly LKPM filings.
en.seo_title: PT PMA Tax Obligations Indonesia 2026: Director's Compliance Guide | CFO AI
en.meta_description: Comprehensive 2026 guide to Indonesian PT PMA taxation: corporate income tax (PPh Badan), PPh 21 TER, PPh 23, PPN 11%, LKPM reporting, and CoreTax PMK 81/2024 rules.
en.content_markdown:
# PT PMA Tax Obligations in Indonesia: Complete 2026 Director's Compliance Guide

Operating a Foreign Direct Investment Company (**Perseroan Terbatas Penanaman Modal Asing / PT PMA**) in Indonesia offers immense market access across Southeast Asia's largest economy. However, foreign directors frequently discover that Indonesia's corporate tax regime is one of the most rigorously enforced withholding-based systems in the world.

With the enforcement of the **Tax Harmonization Law (UU No. 7/2021 / UU HPP)** and the transition to the **DJP CoreTax System under PMK No. 81/2024**, foreign-owned enterprises face strict automated data exchange between commercial banks, OSS RBA, and the Directorate General of Taxes (Direktorat Jenderal Pajak / DJP).

This guide breaks down every core statutory obligation, filing cadence, and documentation standard that foreign directors must maintain in 2026.

---

## 1. Corporate Income Tax (PPh Badan)

The standard Corporate Income Tax rate in Indonesia is **22%** on taxable net profit (Penghasilan Kena Pajak). 

### Key Principles for PT PMA:
- **No Small Business Lump-Sum:** The 0.5% final gross tax rate (PP 55/2022) available to local micro-enterprises (UMKM) is **strictly not applicable to PT PMAs**. Foreign investment companies must maintain full double-entry accrual bookkeeping under Indonesian Financial Accounting Standards (SAK).
- **Article 31E Facility:** Companies with gross annual turnover up to Rp 50 Billion receive a **50% discount** on the standard rate (reducing the effective tax to 11%) on the proportion of taxable income derived from turnover up to Rp 4.8 Billion.
- **Monthly PPh 25 Installments:** Corporate income tax is not paid solely at year-end. Companies must pay monthly advance installments (**PPh Pasal 25**) calculated from the prior year's annual return.

---

## 2. Monthly Withholding Tax Ecosystem (Withholding Obligations)

In Indonesia, corporate entities act as mandatory withholding agents for the government. If your PT PMA pays a vendor, contractor, landlord, or employee, you are legally obligated to withhold the applicable tax at source, issue an official Withholding Slip (**Bukti Pemotongan / e-Bupot**), and remit the tax to DJP by the statutory deadline.

| Withholding Tax Type | Object of Taxation | Standard Statutory Rate | Filing Deadline | Remittance Deadline |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PPh Pasal 21** | Employee salaries, director fees, independent contractors | Progressive Rates / TER (PP 58/2023) | 20th of following month | 10th of following month |
| **PPh Pasal 23** | Domestic services (consulting, legal, IT, marketing, technical), royalties, dividends | 2% (with NPWP) / 4% (without NPWP) | 20th of following month | 10th of following month |
| **PPh Pasal 4 ayat (2)** | Office/warehouse rent, land leasing, construction services | 10% Final (Rent) / 1.75% - 4% (Construction) | 20th of following month | 10th of following month |
| **PPh Pasal 26** | Cross-border payments to foreign entities (management fees, overseas software, interest) | 20% (or reduced Tax Treaty rate with valid DGT-1 form) | 20th of following month | 10th of following month |

> **Critical Compliance Note:** Failure to withhold tax from a vendor invoice does not absolve the PT PMA. Under tax audit, DJP will assess the unpaid withholding tax, plus statutory interest penalties (Tarif Bunga Sanksi Administrasi), directly against the PT PMA.

---

## 3. Value Added Tax (PPN 11%) and PKP Status

- **Threshold:** Any enterprise with gross annual sales exceeding **Rp 4.8 Billion** must register as a Taxable Enterprise (**Pengusaha Kena Pajak / PKP**).
- **Current PPN Rate:** **11%** (governed under UU HPP).
- **Faktur Pajak (Electronic Tax Invoices):** Every taxable supply must be backed by an electronic Faktur Pajak generated via e-Faktur or the CoreTax portal within strict timeframes. Failure to issue Faktur Pajak by the 15th of the following month incurs a mandatory 1% penalty on the transaction value.
- **Input vs. Output Matching:** Companies may credit Input VAT (Pajak Masukan) on business acquisitions against Output VAT (Pajak Keluaran) collected from customers.

---

## 4. Quarterly LKPM Reporting to Ministry of Investment (BKPM)

Beyond tax, PT PMAs are subject to mandatory investment supervision. Under **BKPM Regulation No. 5/2021**, all foreign investment companies must submit the Investment Activity Report (**Laporan Kegiatan Penanaman Modal / LKPM**) electronically via the OSS RBA portal.

### Filing Schedule for Companies with Capital > Rp 500 Million:
- **Quarter I:** April 1 – 10
- **Quarter II:** July 1 – 10
- **Quarter III:** October 1 – 10
- **Quarter IV:** January 1 – 10

### Reported Financial Data:
1. Fixed asset additions (machinery, building improvements, office equipment).
2. Realized working capital expenditures (salaries, raw materials, professional fees).
3. Indonesian vs. expatriate workforce headcount.
4. Realization against the mandatory Rp 10 Billion total investment commitment (excluding land and buildings).

*Sanctions:* BKPM issues formal Written Warnings (Surat Peringatan I, II, III). Failure to rectify leads to the immediate freezing and revocation of your Business Identification Number (**NIB**).

---

## 5. CoreTax PMK 81/2024 Readiness for PT PMA Directors

The implementation of the **CoreTax Administration System (PMK 81/2024)** represents the largest technological leap in Indonesian tax history. CoreTax unifies previously separate portals (DJP Online, e-Billing, e-Faktur, e-Bupot) into a centralized Taxpayer Account Management (TAM) platform.

### Essential Action Checklist:
1. **16-Digit NPWP Validation:** Ensure that foreign directors have validated their 16-digit Tax Identification Number linked to their KITAS/Passport, and that corporate NPWPs use the new 16-digit format.
2. **Clean General Ledger Reconciliation:** In CoreTax, banking data submitted by commercial banks (BCA, Mandiri, Permata) is cross-matched against corporate revenue filings in near-real-time. Unreconciled bank inflows will trigger automated inquiries (SP2DK).
3. **Structured Digital Audit Trail:** Ensure every disbursement has an attached itemized invoice, proof of withholding, and bank payment confirmation.

---

## Statutory Disclaimer
*This publication is prepared for general informational purposes and operational workflow design. It does not constitute formal legal counsel or statutory audit opinions. Indonesian tax laws and implementing regulations are subject to administrative interpretation. Always verify transactions with your licensed Indonesian Tax Consultant (Konsultan Pajak) or registered Public Accounting Firm (KAP).*

id.content_markdown:
# Kewajiban Pajak PT PMA di Indonesia: Panduan Kepatuhan Lengkap Direktur 2026

Menjalankan Perusahaan Penanaman Modal Asing (**PT PMA**) di Indonesia memberikan peluang pasar yang sangat besar di kawasan Asia Tenggara. Namun, para direktur perusahaan sering kali menyadari bahwa sistem perpajakan Indonesia adalah salah satu rezim pemotongan pajak (*withholding tax*) yang paling ketat penegakannya di dunia.

Dengan berlakunya **Undang-Undang Harmonisasi Peraturan Perpajakan (UU No. 7/2021 / UU HPP)** dan masa transisi menuju sistem **CoreTax DJP berdasarkan PMK No. 81/2024**, perusahaan modal asing menghadapi pertukaran data otomatis antara perbankan, OSS RBA, dan Direktorat Jenderal Pajak (DJP).

Panduan ini menguraikan setiap kewajiban hukum utama, jadwal pelaporan, dan standar dokumentasi yang wajib dipatuhi oleh manajemen PT PMA pada tahun 2026.

---

## 1. Pajak Penghasilan Badan (PPh Badan)

Tarif umum Pajak Penghasilan Badan di Indonesia adalah **22%** dari Penghasilan Kena Pajak bersih.

### Prinsip Utama untuk PT PMA:
- **Tidak Berlaku Skema UMKM 0,5%:** Fasilitas PPh Final 0,5% berdasarkan PP 55/2022 untuk usaha mikro **sama sekali tidak berlaku untuk PT PMA**. Perusahaan penanaman modal asing wajib menyelenggarakan pembukuan berpasangan (*double-entry*) berbasis akrual sesuai Standar Akuntansi Keuangan (SAK).
- **Fasilitas Pasal 31E:** PT PMA dengan peredaran bruto hingga Rp 50 Miliar mendapatkan **diskon tarif 50%** (sehingga tarif efektif menjadi 11%) atas bagian penghasilan kena pajak dari omzet sampai dengan Rp 4,8 Miliar.
- **Angsuran Bulanan PPh 25:** PPh Badan tidak hanya disetor pada akhir tahun. Perusahaan wajib menyetor angsuran bulanan PPh Pasal 25 yang dihitung dari SPT Tahunan tahun sebelumnya.

---

## 2. Ekosistem Pemotongan Pajak Bulanan (Withholding Tax)

Di Indonesia, badan usaha bertindak sebagai agen pemotong pajak pemerintah. Setiap kali PT PMA membayar tagihan vendor, kontraktor, sewa gedung, atau gaji karyawan, perusahaan wajib memotong pajak di sumber, menerbitkan Bukti Pemotongan (**e-Bupot**), dan menyetorkannya ke kas negara.

| Jenis Pajak Pemotongan | Objek Pajak | Tarif Standar | Batas Waktu Lapor | Batas Waktu Setor |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PPh Pasal 21** | Gaji karyawan, upah tenaga ahli, honorarium | Tarif Progresif / TER (PP 58/2023) | Tanggal 20 bulan berikutnya | Tanggal 10 bulan berikutnya |
| **PPh Pasal 23** | Jasa teknik, manajemen, konsultasi, sewa aset, dividen | 2% (ber-NPWP) / 4% (tanpa NPWP) | Tanggal 20 bulan berikutnya | Tanggal 10 bulan berikutnya |
| **PPh Pasal 4 ayat (2)** | Sewa tanah/bangunan, jasa konstruksi | 10% Final (Sewa) / 1,75% - 4% (Konstruksi) | Tanggal 20 bulan berikutnya | Tanggal 10 bulan berikutnya |
| **PPh Pasal 26** | Pembayaran ke entitas luar negeri (manajemen, royalti, bunga) | 20% (atau tarif P3B / Tax Treaty dengan Form DGT-1) | Tanggal 20 bulan berikutnya | Tanggal 10 bulan berikutnya |

---

## 3. Pajak Pertambahan Nilai (PPN 11%) dan Pengukuhan PKP

- **Ambang Batas PKP:** Perusahaan dengan peredaran bruto melebihi **Rp 4,8 Miliar** dalam satu tahun buku wajib dikukuhkan sebagai Pengusaha Kena Pajak (**PKP**).
- **Tarif PPN:** **11%** (UU HPP).
- **Faktur Pajak Elektronik:** Setiap penyerahan Barang/Jasa Kena Pajak wajib disertai Faktur Pajak elektronik (e-Faktur). Keterlambatan penerbitan dikenakan denda administratif 1% dari Dasar Pengenaan Pajak (DPP).

---

## 4. Pelaporan LKPM Kuartalan ke Kementerian Investasi (BKPM)

Berdasarkan **Peraturan BKPM No. 5/2021**, seluruh PT PMA wajib menyampaikan Laporan Kegiatan Penanaman Modal (**LKPM**) secara triwulanan melalui sistem OSS RBA.

### Jadwal Pelaporan Kuartal:
- **Kuartal I:** 1 – 10 April
- **Kuartal II:** 1 – 10 Juli
- **Kuartal III:** 1 – 10 Oktober
- **Kuartal IV:** 1 – 10 Januari

# Налоговые обязательства компаний PT PMA в Индонезии: руководство для директоров 2026

Управление компанией с иностранными инвестициями (**PT PMA**) в Индонезии открывает доступ к крупнейшей экономике Юго-Восточной Азии. Однако иностранные учредители и директора часто сталкиваются с тем, что налоговая система Индонезии является одной из самых строго контролируемых систем удержания налогов у источника (*withholding tax*).

В связи с вступлением в силу **Закона о гармонизации налогового законодательства (UU No. 7/2021 / UU HPP)** и переходом на цифровую налоговую платформу **CoreTax (PMK No. 81/2024)**, бизнес в Индонезии находится под прямым автоматическим контролем налоговой службы (DJP) и инвестиционного министерства (BKPM).

В этом руководстве детально разобраны все обязательства, ставки и график отчетности для директоров PT PMA на 2026 год.

---

## 1. Корпоративный подоходный налог (PPh Badan)

Базовая ставка корпоративного налога на прибыль в Индонезии составляет **22%** от чистой налогооблагаемой прибыли.

### Важные правила для PT PMA:
- **Упрощенная ставка 0,5% не применяется:** Льготный налог с оборота 0,5% для малого бизнеса (PP 55/2022) **категорически запрещен для компаний PT PMA**. Иностранные предприятия обязаны вести полноценный бухгалтерский учет по методу начисления в соответствии с индонезийскими стандартами SAK.
- **Льгота по Статье 31E:** Компании с годовой выручкой до 50 млрд индонезийских рупий получают **скидку 50%** на ставку налога (эффективная ставка 11%) на долю прибыли, приходящуюся на оборот до 4,8 млрд IDR.
- **Ежемесячные авансовые платежи PPh 25:** Налог на прибыль не выплачивается разово в конце года. Компания обязана ежемесячно перечислять авансовые взносы PPh 25, рассчитанные на базе предыдущей годовой декларации.

---

## 2. Налоги у источника выплаты (Withholding Taxes)

В Индонезии юридические лица являются налоговыми агентами государства. При оплате услуг подрядчиков, аренды или зарплат компания обязана удержать налог, выпустить официальную справку об удержании (**e-Bupot**) и перечислить налог в бюджет.

| Тип налога | Объект налогообложения | Ставка | Срок подачи декларации | Срок уплаты налога |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PPh 21** | Заработная плата сотрудников, вознаграждения директоров | Прогрессивная шкала / TER (PP 58/2023) | До 20-го числа след. месяца | До 10-го числа след. месяца |
| **PPh 23** | Услуги местных компаний (консалтинг, IT, маркетинг, аренда оборудования) | 2% (с NPWP) / 4% (без NPWP) | До 20-го числа след. месяца | До 10-го числа след. месяца |
| **PPh 4(2)** | Аренда офиса, земли, складов, строительные работы | 10% (Аренда) / 1.75% - 4% (Стройка) | До 20-го числа след. месяца | До 10-го числа след. месяца |
| **PPh 26** | Выплаты иностранным компаниям (роялти, зарубежное ПО, проценты) | 20% (или сниженная ставка по соглашению об избежании двойного налогообложения с формой DGT-1) | До 20-го числа след. месяца | До 10-го числа след. месяца |

---

## 3. НДС (PPN 11%) и статус PKP

- **Порог обязательной регистрации:** При достижении выручки свыше **4,8 млрд индонезийских рупий** за финансовый год компания обязана зарегистрироваться плательщиком НДС (**PKP**).
- **Ставка НДС:** **11%**.
- **Электронные счета-фактуры (Faktur Pajak):** Каждая облагаемая операция должна сопровождаться электронной фактурой, сформированной в государственной системе e-Faktur.

---

## 4. Ежеквартальная отчетность LKPM в BKPM

Согласно **Положению BKPM № 5/2021**, все компании PT PMA обязаны ежеквартально подавать инвестиционный отчет (**LKPM**) через портал OSS RBA.

### Календарь сдачи LKPM:
- **I квартал:** 1 – 10 апреля
- **II квартал:** 1 – 10 июля
- **III квартал:** 1 – 10 октября
- **IV квартал:** 1 – 10 января

Несоблюдение сроков влечет выдачу предупреждений (SP 1, SP 2, SP 3) и аннулирование лицензии NIB.

---

## Официальная правовая оговорка

Всегда сверяйте налоговые расчеты с лицензированным индонезийским налоговым консультантом (Konsultan Pajak) или аудиторской компанией (KAP).*

en.content_markdown:
# PPh 21 TER Withholding Tax Under PP 58/2023: Formulas, Monthly Brackets & Payroll Reconciliation

Starting in 2024 and cemented under **Government Regulation (PP) No. 58/2023** and **Finance Minister Regulation (PMK) No. 168/2023**, Indonesia completely restructured how personal income tax (**PPh Pasal 21**) is withheld from monthly employee compensation.

The historical method—which required payroll clerks to annualize monthly income, subtract occupational allowances (Biaya Jabatan) and non-taxable income (PTKP), calculate progressive Article 17 brackets, and divide by 12 every single month—has been abolished for months January through November.

In its place stands the **Tarif Efektif Rata-Rata (TER)** mechanism: a simplified monthly lookup table based on gross earnings, coupled with a mandatory reconciliation in December.

---

## 1. The Three Monthly TER Categories (A, B, C)

The applicable monthly TER bracket depends strictly on the employee's non-taxable income status (**Penghasilan Tidak Kena Pajak / PTKP**) at the beginning of the tax year:

### Category A
- **Applicable to:** Single with no dependents (TK/0), Single with 1 dependent (TK/1), or Married with no dependents (K/0).
- **Brackets:** 44 distinct monthly salary tiers. Gross monthly income up to Rp 5,400,000 incurs **0%** withholding. Above Rp 5.4M, rates start at 0.25% and scale up to 34% for monthly earnings over Rp 1.4 Billion.

### Category B
- **Applicable to:** TK/2, TK/3, K/1, K/2.
- **Brackets:** 40 tiers. Zero-tax threshold extends up to Rp 6,200,000 per month (0%).

### Category C
- **Applicable to:** Married with 3 dependents (K/3).
- **Brackets:** 41 tiers. Zero-tax threshold extends up to Rp 6,600,000 per month (0%).

---

## 2. Monthly Calculation Formula (January – November)

During months 1 through 11, withholding calculation requires only one simple multiplication:

$$\text{Monthly PPh 21 Withholding} = \text{Gross Monthly Earnings} \times \text{TER Rate (\%)}$$

### Worked Example:
- Employee: Senior Developer, status K/1 (Category B).
- Gross Salary in March: Rp 18,500,000.
- Lookup in Category B Table: Monthly gross between Rp 17,750,000 and Rp 19,500,000 carries a TER rate of **7%**.
- Monthly Withholding: $\text{Rp } 18,500,000 \times 7\% = \mathbf{\text{Rp } 1,295,000}$.

---

## 3. The December Month-Close Reconciliation

The monthly TER rate is an *administrative withholding estimate*. It does not replace the permanent annual progressive rates under Article 17 paragraph (1) letter a of the Income Tax Law.

In December (the final tax period of the year), the employer must perform an annual true-up:
1. Sum all gross compensation earned from January to December (including base salary, allowances, bonuses, THR, and employer-paid BPJS contributions).
2. Deduct allowable annual deductions: Biaya Jabatan (5% of gross, max Rp 6,000,000/year), employee BPJS Ketenagakerjaan contributions (JHT 2%, JP 1%), and the employee's annual PTKP.
3. Compute the **Actual Annual PPh 21** using progressive Article 17 brackets (5% up to Rp 60M, 15% from Rp 60M to Rp 250M, 25% from Rp 250M to Rp 500M, 30% from Rp 500M to Rp 5B, 35% above Rp 5B).
4. Deduct the total PPh 21 already withheld during January through November.
5. The difference is the December withholding amount (or refund if over-withheld).

$$\text{PPh 21 December} = \text{Total Annual Article 17 Tax} - \sum_{m=1}^{11} \text{PPh 21 Paid (TER)}$$

---

## Statutory Disclaimer
*This article provides operational payroll calculation guidance. It does not replace formal tax consultations. Always verify complex severance, expatriate tax residency, or multi-employer scenarios with a licensed Indonesian tax advisor.*

# Perhitungan PPh 21 TER Berdasarkan PP 58/2023: Formula, Tarif Bulanan & Rekonsiliasi Payroll

Sejak berlakunya **Peraturan Pemerintah (PP) No. 58/2023** dan **Peraturan Menteri Keuangan (PMK) No. 168/2023**, mekanisme pemotongan Pajak Penghasilan Pasal 21 atas penghasilan karyawan di Indonesia mengalami penyederhanaan yang mendasar.

Metode lama yang mewajibkan perusahaan menghitung estimasi penghasilan neto disetahunkan setiap bulan kini telah dihapus untuk masa pajak Januari sampai dengan November. Sebagai gantinya, pemerintah memberlakukan mekanisme **Tarif Efektif Rata-Rata (TER)** bulanan.

---

## 1. Tiga Kategori TER Bulanan (A, B, dan C)

Penentuan tabel TER yang berlaku didasarkan pada status Penghasilan Tidak Kena Pajak (**PTKP**) karyawan pada awal tahun pajak:
- **Kategori A:** TK/0, TK/1, K/0 (Batas nihil pajak hingga Rp 5,4 juta per bulan).
- **Kategori B:** TK/2, TK/3, K/1, K/2 (Batas nihil pajak hingga Rp 6,2 juta per bulan).
- **Kategori C:** K/3 (Batas nihil pajak hingga Rp 6,6 juta per bulan).

---

## 2. Formula Pemotongan Masa Januari – November

$$\text{PPh 21 Masa Bulanan} = \text{Penghasilan Bruto Sebulan} \times \text{Tarif TER (\%)}$$

Perhitungan bulanan menjadi instan dan mengurangi risiko perbedaan kalkulasi manual di bagian HR dan keuangan.

---

## 3. Rekonsiliasi Masa Pajak Desember

Pada bulan Desember, perusahaan menghitung kembali total PPh 21 terutang setahun penuh menggunakan tarif progresif Pasal 17 ayat (1) huruf a UU PPh, kemudian dikurangi seluruh pemotongan TER yang telah disetor dari Januari hingga November.

# Расчет налога на доходы PPh 21 TER по PP 58/2023: формулы, шкалы и зарплатный учет в Индонезии

С 2024 года в соответствии с **Постановлением Правительства (PP) № 58/2023** и **Постановлением Минфина (PMK) № 168/2023** Индонезия кардинально обновила порядок удержания подоходного налога с физических лиц (**PPh 21**).

Старый сложный алгоритм, требовавший ежемесячного приведения зарплаты к годовому эквиваленту и вычета необлагаемого минимума, заменен механизмом **средних эффективных ставок (TER)** для месяцев с января по ноябрь.

---

## 1. Три категории ставок TER (A, B, C)

Категория зависит от семейного статуса сотрудника (**PTKP**) на 1 января налогового года:
- **Категория A:** Холост/не замужем без иждивенцев (TK/0, TK/1), женат/замужем без детей (K/0). Необлагаемый порог — до 5,4 млн рупий в месяц (0%).
- **Категория B:** TK/2, TK/3, K/1, K/2. Необлагаемый порог — до 6,2 млн рупий в месяц (0%).
- **Категория C:** Женат/замужем с 3 детьми (K/3). Необлагаемый порог — до 6,6 млн рупий в месяц (0%).

---

## 2. Формула ежемесячного удержания (январь – ноябрь)

$$\text{Удержание PPh 21} = \text{Грязный доход за месяц (Gross)} \times \text{Ставка TER (\%)}$$

В декабре работодатель рассчитывает совокупный годовой налог по постоянной прогрессивной шкале Статьи 17 и вычитает суммы, уплаченные по TER за предыдущие 11 месяцев.

# CoreTax PMK 81/2024 Transition: Preparing Bank Feeds, e-Bupot & General Ledgers

Indonesia's Directorate General of Taxes (DJP) is executing the most comprehensive digital transformation in its history: the **CoreTax Administration System (Sistem Inti Administrasi Perpajakan / SIAP)**, codified under **Finance Minister Regulation (PMK) No. 81/2024**.

CoreTax is not simply a visual redesign of DJP Online. It represents a unified data architecture where 21 distinct administrative processes—including taxpayer registration, e-Faktur issuance, e-Bupot unifikasi, tax deposits, refund requests, and audit tracking—are consolidated into a real-time **Taxpayer Account Management (TAM)** core.

For Indonesian business owners and CFOs, CoreTax fundamentally eliminates the buffer between operational accounting and tax enforcement. Under CoreTax, commercial bank feeds, customs declarations, and supplier invoices are continuously reconciled against reported tax filings.

---

## 1. Structural Changes Codified Under PMK 81/2024

### A. Unified 16-Digit Taxpayer Identification
All corporate and individual taxpayers are unified under a standard 16-digit format. For Indonesian citizens, this corresponds to the National Identity Number (NIK). For corporate entities and foreign nationals, the legacy 15-digit NPWP is migrated to an updated 16-digit format. Systems issuing invoices or withholding slips with invalid NPWPs are rejected automatically at API boundaries.

### B. Interoperable e-Bupot Unifikasi 2.0
Under CoreTax, withholding slips are no longer isolated XML uploads. When Company A withholds PPh 23 on a service fee paid to Company B, the e-Bupot voucher is instantly posted to Company B's Taxpayer Account. Company B can immediately claim the tax credit without manual document exchange or lost physical paper copies.

### C. Automated Bank Data Triangulation
Under Law No. 9/2017 and PMK 81/2024, commercial banks in Indonesia (including BCA, Mandiri, BRI, BNI, and Permata) report transaction velocity and account balance snapshots to DJP. In CoreTax, discrepancies between gross bank inflows and reported taxable revenue trigger automated **SP2DK** (Surat Permintaan Penjelasan atas Data dan/atau Keterangan) inquiry letters within weeks, rather than years later during retrospective audits.

---

## 2. The 5-Step CoreTax Preparation Runbook

Finance teams must execute five audit steps before the full mandatory cutover:

1. **Clean General Ledger Reconciliation:** Ensure that every bank transaction in your corporate accounts (BCA Giro, Permata, cash) is tied to a documented invoice or balance transfer. Unreconciled bank lines will be presumed taxable revenue under audit.
2. **Counterparty NPWP 16-Digit Master Audit:** Run an audit across your active vendor and client databases to ensure all legal entities have recorded valid 16-digit NPWPs and accurate registered business addresses.
3. **DPP and PPN Separation:** Verify that accounting entries strictly segregate Base Tax Value (DPP) from PPN 11% and withholding taxes, matching the electronic Faktur Pajak.
4. **Employee PTKP Status Review:** Verify employee marital and dependent declarations (TK/0 through K/3) to ensure monthly PPh 21 TER brackets are applied accurately.
5. **Standardized Readiness Package Export:** Implement accounting tools capable of generating unified month-close reconciliation archives (CSV and PDF) for instant verification.

---

## 3. How CFO AI Accelerates CoreTax Readiness

CFO AI was engineered from the ground up to support modern Indonesian tax compliance:
- Automated OCR extracting vendor legal names, 16-digit NPWPs, DPP, and PPN 11%.
- Direct bank reconciliation matching imported BCA Giro CSVs and Permata PDFs against unpaid bills.
- One-click downloadable **Accountant Readiness Package (ZIP)** containing clean reconciliation CSVs and bilingual summary reports formatted for immediate compliance review.

---

## Statutory Disclaimer
*This article is published for technical and administrative preparation purposes. It does not replace advice from a licensed Indonesian tax attorney or registered Konsultan Pajak.*

Завершенная банковская сверка за закрываемый период

steps.title: Перейдите в раздел Бухгалтер
steps.instruction: В боковом меню выберите раздел 'Бухгалтер' (Accountant).

steps.title: Выберите закрываемый период
steps.instruction: Укажите отчетный месяц и год для формирования архива.

steps.title: Проверьте чеклист готовности
steps.instruction: Убедитесь, что все банковские строки сопоставлены, а ожидающие чеки проверены.

steps.title: Сформируйте ZIP-пакет
steps.instruction: Нажмите 'Сформировать пакет бухгалтера' и скачайте архив с реестрами в Excel и каталогом прикрепленных чеков.

ru.expected_result: Готовый структурированный ZIP-архив, который можно сразу отправить вашему налоговому консультанту.

en.title: Setting Up Team Members and Running Monthly Payroll
en.summary: Manage salary components, calculate PPh 21 TER withholding previews, and record approved salary disbursements.
en.what_you_accomplish: Organized payroll cycles compliant with Indonesian tax rules, creating auditable salary records and disbursements.
prerequisites: Admin or Owner role
Staff salary contracts and BPJS/tax status details

steps.title: Open Payroll Screen
steps.instruction: In the left navigation sidebar, click 'Payroll'.

steps.title: Set Up Staff Profiles
steps.instruction: Add staff with their legal names, Indonesian NIK/NPWP, monthly base salary, allowances, and PTKP tax category.

steps.title: Initiate Payroll Cycle
steps.instruction: Click 'Run Monthly Payroll', select the pay period, and review the automatic PPh 21 TER withholding calculations.

steps.title: Approve & Record Disbursement
steps.instruction: Review gross-to-net totals, approve the run, and link the disbursement to your bank checking account.

en.expected_result: Payroll entries post to your ledger, PPh 21 tax liability is tracked, and individual salary slips can be generated.

troubleshooting.solution: Update the staff member's PTKP category under Payroll > Staff Directory; subsequent cycles will apply the updated withholding percentage.

en.keywords: payroll salary pph 21 ter staff employees approval disbursement

id.title: Menyiapkan Data Karyawan & Menjalankan Penggajian Bulanan
id.summary: Kelola komponen gaji, hitung estimasi potongan PPh 21 TER, dan catat persetujuan pembayaran gaji staf.
id.what_you_accomplish: Menjalankan siklus penggajian bulanan yang rapi sesuai regulasi pajak Indonesia dan mencatat pengeluaran gaji secara akuntabel.
prerequisites: Peran Admin atau Pemilik
Data kontrak gaji staf dan status PTKP/BPJS karyawan

steps.title: Buka Menu Penggajian (Payroll)
steps.instruction: Pada menu bilah samping kiri, klik 'Payroll'.

steps.title: Lengkapi Data Profil Karyawan
steps.instruction: Tambahkan staf beserta nama resmi, NIK/NPWP, gaji pokok, tunjangan rutin, dan kategori status PTKP (TK/0, K/1, dsb).

steps.title: Mulai Siklus Penggajian
steps.instruction: Klik 'Jalankan Penggajian Bulanan', tentukan periode bulan gaji, dan tinjau perhitungan tarif efektif rata-rata PPh 21 TER.

steps.title: Setujui & Catat Pembayaran
steps.instruction: Periksa total gaji kotor hingga bersih, setujui penggajian, dan tautkan pengeluaran ke rekening bank sumber pembayaran.

id.expected_result: Catatan beban gaji tercatat di pembukuan, kewajiban PPh 21 terpantau, dan slip gaji staf dapat diunduh.

troubleshooting.error: Status PTKP karyawan berubah di tengah tahun
troubleshooting.solution: Perbarui status PTKP di menu Direktori Staf; siklus penggajian berikutnya akan otomatis menerapkan persentase tarif TER yang sesuai.

id.keywords: penggajian payroll gaji karyawan pph 21 ter ptkp slip gaji

ru.title: Настройка сотрудников и начисление ежемесячной зарплаты
ru.summary: Учет окладов, предварительный расчет индонезийского налога PPh 21 TER и утверждение зарплатных выплат.
ru.what_you_accomplish: Ежемесячный расчет зарплат в соответствии с индонезийскими налоговыми правилами и прозрачная фиксация выплат в учете.
prerequisites: Роль Admin или Owner
Трудовые договоры, оклады и налоговые статусы PTKP сотрудников

steps.title: Откройте раздел Зарплата (Payroll)
steps.instruction: В левом меню навигации выберите раздел 'Payroll'.

steps.title: Заполните карточки сотрудников
steps.instruction: Внесите имя по паспорту/KTP, налоговый номер, оклад, надбавки и семейный налоговый статус PTKP.

steps.title: Запустите зарплатный цикл
steps.instruction: Нажмите 'Рассчитать зарплату', выберите месяц и проверьте автоматический расчет удержания налога PPh 21 TER.

steps.title: Утвердите выплату
steps.instruction: Проверьте итоговые суммы к выплате, утвердите расчет и привяжите списание к расчетному счету.

ru.expected_result: Затраты на ФОТ отражаются в расходах компании, налог PPh 21 фиксируется к оплате, формируются зарплатные ведомости.

troubleshooting.solution: Отредактируйте статус в профиле сотрудника; при следующем начислении зарплаты будет применен обновленный процент TER.

ru.keywords: зарплата начисление payroll pph 21 ter сотрудники оклады налоги индонезия

en.title: Using AI CFO for Financial Queries and Runway Insights

Viewer, Accountant, Admin, or Owner role

steps.title: Open AI CFO Console
steps.instruction: Click 'AI CFO' in the navigation bar.

steps.title: Enter Natural-Language Prompt
steps.instruction: Type your query, e.g. 'What was our total software spend in Q1?' or 'What is our current cash runway in days?'

steps.title: Inspect Cited Calculations
steps.instruction: Review the AI summary alongside clickable references to the specific ledger entries and accounts used in the answer.

en.expected_result: Clear, verifiable analysis grounded strictly in your company's isolated financial ledger data.

troubleshooting.error: Prompt asks for external tax advice
troubleshooting.solution: AI CFO is strictly bounded to analyze your internal transactions. For statutory tax filing opinions, consult your licensed Konsultan Pajak.

en.keywords: ai cfo query prompt analysis insight runway trends chat assistant

id.title: Menggunakan AI CFO untuk Kueri Keuangan & Analisis Runway

Peran Viewer, Akuntan, Admin, atau Pemilik

steps.title: Buka Konsol AI CFO

steps.title: Ajukan Pertanyaan Bahasa Sehari-hari
steps.instruction: Ketik pertanyaan seperti 'Berapa total belanja perangkat lunak kuartal ini?' atau 'Berapa hari sisa runway kas kita?'

steps.title: Tinjau Sitasi & Rujukan Data
steps.instruction: Periksa rangkuman jawaban beserta rujukan transaksi pembukuan nyata yang mendasari analisis tersebut.

id.expected_result: Analisis akurat yang bersumber secara ketat dari data pembukuan internal perusahaan Anda yang terisolasi aman.

troubleshooting.solution: AI CFO dibatasi secara tegas hanya untuk menganalisis data pembukuan Anda. Untuk nasihat hukum pajak, konsultasikan dengan konsultan pajak terdaftar.

id.keywords: ai cfo asisten kueri analisis arus kas tren pengeluaran runway tanya keuangan

ru.title: Использование AI CFO для финансовых вопросов и анализа runway
ru.summary: Как задавать вопросы на естественном языке об остатках денег, расходах по поставщикам и динамике затрат.
ru.what_you_accomplish: Быстрые ответы на управленческие вопросы о финансах без необходимости строить сводные таблицы в Excel.

Роль Viewer, Accountant, Admin или Owner

steps.title: Откройте консоль AI CFO
steps.instruction: В верхнем меню выберите раздел 'AI CFO'.

steps.title: Задайте вопрос на обычном языке
steps.instruction: Напишите, например: 'Сколько мы потратили на софт в прошлом месяце?' или 'Какой у нас текущий запас денег в днях?'

steps.title: Ознакомьтесь с обоснованием ответа
steps.instruction: Изучите краткий вывод и проверьте прямые ссылки на строки выписок и счетов, по которым сделан расчет.

ru.expected_result: Точный структурированный ответ, основанный исключительно на подтвержденных данных из книг вашей компании.

troubleshooting.error: Вопрос касается юридической консультации по налогам
troubleshooting.solution: AI CFO анализирует только фактические данные вашей компании. За официальными налоговыми разъяснениями обращайтесь к Konsultan Pajak.

ru.keywords: ai cfo финансовый ассистент вопросы аналитика runway расходы анализ трендов

steps.instruction: Navigate to Accountant > Auto-Categorization Queue.

steps.title: Inspect Proposed Categories
steps.instruction: Review transactions where AI has suggested account codes based on vendor history and description.

steps.instruction: Click 'Approve' to commit the category, or select a different account from the dropdown.

en.expected_result: Transactions are categorized under human supervision with zero automated unilateral changes to statutory tax accounts.

steps.title: Tinjau Usulan Kategori
steps.instruction: Periksa transaksi yang diberi saran kode akun oleh AI berdasarkan riwayat transaksi vendor serupa.

steps.instruction: Klik 'Setujui' untuk menyepakati usulan, atau pilih akun beban lain dari menu pilihan.

troubleshooting.solution: Cukup pilih akun yang benar secara manual; sistem akan mengingat pilihan Anda untuk transaksi mendatang dari vendor tersebut.
